name: ra_tools_admin
description: Web assets for the Ramblers Tools administrator template. Structural CSS/JS (layout, responsive behaviour, sidebar collapse, dark-mode watching) are loaded directly from the installed Atum template's own compiled files by URL — not copied — because a template's web-asset registry entries are only loaded while that template is active, so cross-template asset-name dependencies cannot be used here. This template requires Atum to remain installed.

assets.name: template.ra_tools_admin.ltr
assets.description: Atum's own compiled structural CSS (LTR), referenced directly by URL.

assets.name: template.ra_tools_admin.rtl
assets.description: Atum's own compiled structural CSS (RTL), referenced directly by URL.

assets.name: template.ra_tools_admin.brand
assets.description: Ramblers Tools branding overlay, loaded after the structural CSS above.

assets.name: template.ra_tools_admin.dashboard-preview
assets.description: PROTOTYPE ONLY: visual restyle of com_ra_tools's dashboard, loaded only on that view, targeting its existing .dashboard-grid/.dashboard-block markup. No com_ra_tools files are modified. For evaluating the new look before committing to a real component-side change.

assets.name: template.ra_tools_admin.dashboard-preview
assets.description: PROTOTYPE ONLY: swaps dashboard block-header text for product logos, matched by title. Logos are template-local copies for this test only.

assets.name: template.active.language
assets.description: An asset to allow language specific css to use as a dependency to the active template

assets.name: template.user
assets.description: A file where a user can add their own css.

assets.name: template.ra_tools_admin
assets.description: Atum's own compiled template.js (sidebar collapse, dark-mode watching, responsive behaviour), referenced directly by URL.

assets.name: template.active
assets.description: A dummy asset to allow extensions to use it as a dependency to the active template

assets.name: searchtools
assets.description: Core intentionally ships no default CSS for this asset (uri: "") and expects the active template to supply one — reused directly from Atum's compiled file by URL.
